items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Supported revenue covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. Site-attributed commission is $0 because the aggregate row cannot be assigned without inventing attribution. AI usage is $973.3548129 across 5,439 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27, conflicting with retained records of $966.82985915 across 5,417 calls through 2026-09-26 and $963.5690377 across 5,390 calls. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable: revenue and cost windows are misaligned; period-aligned infrastructure, domain, labor, and marketing costs are absent; incremental outcomes are not isolated; and monthly spend, marketing, revenue-target, and revenue-floor limits are blank. Minimum measurement: one reconciled period-aligned ledger by site and page/content identifier covering revenue, AI, infrastructure, domains, labor, and marketing costs, plus experiment exposure/control and incremental outcome records. Authorize only existing reconciliation; no discretionary spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported revenue claims.
